title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: waterproofing
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Basement tanking and lift pit membranes
swms.task: Apply waterproofing membranes to the basement walls and floors and inside the lift pits and sumps, grinding the concrete surfaces first, and applying solvent-based primers and liquid membranes.

facts.silicaControls: Concrete is ground with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while grinding. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the primer and polyurethane membrane are kept at the work area: flammable, use with ventilation, keep away from ignition sources, wear gloves, goggles and a half-face respirator.
facts.fallControl: Lift pits and sumps have a guard rail with a gate, and access is by a secured ladder.
facts.confinedSpace: Entry to lift pits and sumps is only under a confined space entry permit, with atmospheric testing before and during entry, vapour extracted from the lowest point with fresh air introduced from above, a standby person at the opening, and a practised rescue plan.

steps: Prepare to enter the confined space
missing: Pits, tanks, sumps or manholes entered

swms.title: Roof and podium torch-on membranes
swms.task: Lay torch-on bitumen sheet membranes on the roof and podium next to the edge, lifting the membrane rolls by hoist.

facts.hotWorkPermit: The principal contractor issues a hot work permit each day, with a fire extinguisher at each work area and a fire watch after torching ends.
facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed around the roof and podium perimeter before work starts, and no one works outside it.

swms.title: Apartment wet area and balcony membranes
swms.task: Apply liquid waterproofing membranes to the apartment bathrooms and balconies, with water-based primers.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the water-based primer and membrane are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.fallControl: Balcony balustrades or temporary edge protection stay in place, and no one works outside them.
